niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers clean, modern mobile UIs with strong information hierarchy, clear grouping into cards or sections, high readability, and polished but restrained styling. They often favor light, airy layouts with soft rounded surfaces, generous spacing, explicit actions, and interfaces that feel easy to scan. They also like contemporary chip/tab treatments, clear navigation structure, and content-rich screens when the added content improves usefulness and hierarchy rather than adding noise.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers clear top-down hierarchy with prominent headings, well-separated metadata, and obvious focal points that make screens easy to scan.
Prefers content grouped into distinct cards or clearly labeled sections rather than flat lists, fragmented rows, or weakly separated blocks.
Prefers high-contrast text, legible labels, and content presentation that is immediately easy to read and understand.
Prefers soft rounded surfaces, subtle borders, gentle contours, and contemporary polished styling over boxy, harsh, dated, or skeuomorphic treatments.
Prefers explicit navigation cues such as back arrows, bottom navigation, chevrons, and other structural signals that clarify where to go and where they are.
Prefers bold, obvious, clearly labeled actions and strong selection states over subtle links, ambiguous rows, or weak button emphasis.
Prefers lightweight modern chips, pill filters, integrated search, and simpler control clusters over bulky segmented tabs, crowded top controls, or heavier form-like selectors.
